history.new: Weak support. The maximum is 14 up to 2e5 (13 first at 12,071, 14 at 48,652), but the Skeptic's computation to 1e8 finds new records just outside the lab's range - 15 first at n = 206,025 and 16 at n = 63,331,966. P-density stays in 0.165-0.180 up to 1e8. 'Unchanged up to 2e5' was true but misleading; the values may well be unbounded.

limitations: Weak support. The maximum is 14 up to 2e5 (13 first at 12,071, 14 at 48,652), but the Skeptic's computation to 1e8 finds new records just outside the lab's range - 15 first at n = 206,025 and 16 at n = 63,331,966. notes: The P-density is at most 1/5 by Pond and Howells (1965), as cited in OEIS A001581; measured 0.180 at n <= 2e5.
statement:
The Grundy values of the subtraction game with move set {1, 2, 3, 5, 8, ...} (Fibonacci numbers) are bounded;
the observed maximum is 14 for n <= 2e5.
title: Subtract-a-Fibonacci-number has bounded Grundy values
